name: N00d Token
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to enter, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires understanding ERC777 hook-based reentrancy plus how the SushiBar enter/leave accounting can be abused during a Uniswap V2 flash swap callback. While the PoC is not very long, it is a multi-step attack with repeated flash-swapped reentry loops and protocol-specific logic, making it more than a straightforward pattern match.
